text.description_html:
Don-Jo CFK71, 4" x 16" Push Plate with 2-1/8" Cut-out

This 4" wide x 16" high commercial door push plate has a cylinder hole cut-out perfect for adding a lock or lever. The 4" x 16" Push Plate with Hole is primarily used in commercial applications such as in restaurants, warehouses, factories, and stores. It is made from .050" solid brass with a polished brass finish.

This commercial push plate is made in the USA by Don-Jo Manufacturing.

Specifications of Don-Jo CFK71 Push Plate with Cut-Out:

  • Plate Height: 16"
  • Plate Width: 4"
  • Hole Diameter: 2-1/8"
  • Top of hole is 3-3/4" from top edge of plate.
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged with mounting screws.

*Sold Individually.
